items.title: Jack Lesberg interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: Tommy Dorsey and Sarah Vaughan are a few of the giants of American music who have employed Jack.

ctx.x: Versatility has been the key behind the career of bassist Jack Lesberg. Jack was born in Boston on February 14, 1920 and started on the violin as a child. He played in public at an early age, eventually finding the string bass as his instrument of choice. Throughout his career he has alternated between jazz, classical and commercial studio work and his lengthy discography speaks highly of the respect that fellow musicians hold for his work. Leonard Bernstein, Louis Armstrong, Tommy Dorsey and Sarah Vaughan are a…

Jack was interviewed by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive, at the Jerome Jazz Party in Aspen, Colorado on October 11, 1997. In addition to performing, Jack co-directed this event with longtime friend, pianist Ralph Sutton.
